description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal full-time role offers a unique opportunity to shape the quality of patient care and foster a supportive environment for both residents and staff. You will be instrumental in upholding the highest standards of nursing practice and operational excellence.As the Director of Nursing, you will oversee all nursing operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and implementing best practices in patient care. This role is ideal for a compassionate leader ready to make a significant impact within a dynamic healthcare setting. We offer a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, commensurate with your experience and expertise.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Proven experience as a Director of Nursing (DON) or Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON).
Minimum of 2-3 years of leadership experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care facility.
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $85,000 to $95,000 per year, based on experience.
